_google: OPTIONAL — direct Google sign-in so the consent screen reads 'Aethron' (not '<ref>.supabase.co') and works from the native desktop window. Create a Google Cloud OAuth client of type 'Desktop app', register its Client ID in Supabase -> Auth -> Providers -> Google -> Authorized Client IDs, then fill these. The desktop client secret is non-confidential by design (OAuth for native apps + PKCE), so baking it into the app is expected. Omit both to fall back to Supabase's brokered redirect.
